name: wget
readme:
Short:        HTTP/HTTPS download utility
Type:         comm/tcp
Architecture: m68k-amigaos >= 3.0; 68020+
Uploader:     duncan (at) bowring (dot) us
Author:       Free Software Foundation (ported by Duncan Bowring)
Version:      1.20.3

wget - HTTP/HTTPS download utility

GNU Wget is a non-interactive network retriever. It supports HTTP,
FTP, recursive downloading, resume of interrupted transfers, cookies,
authentication, proxy support, and many other features.

Original author: Free Software Foundation
Ported by Duncan Bowring using amiport (AI-assisted porting toolkit).
Project: https://github.com/bdgscotland/amiport

Cross-compiled with m68k-amigaos-gcc for AmigaOS 3.x (68020+).
Requires bsdsocket.library (Roadshow, AmiTCP, or Miami).

Usage:
  wget http://example.com/file.lha
  wget -O output.txt http://example.com/page.html
  wget -c http://example.com/large-file.lha   (resume download)
  wget -r -l 2 http://example.com/            (recursive, depth 2)
  wget -q http://example.com/file.lha         (quiet mode)

Features:
  - HTTP and FTP downloads
  - Recursive download with depth control
  - Resume interrupted downloads (-c)
  - Cookie support (--load-cookies, --save-cookies)
  - HTTP authentication (--user, --password)
  - Proxy support (http_proxy environment variable)
  - Progress bar with ETA
  - Timestamping (-N, only download if newer)
  - Spider mode (--spider, check links only)
  - Custom user-agent (--user-agent)
  - Custom headers (--header)

Known limitations:
  - HTTPS not yet supported (Phase 2 via AmiSSL planned)
  - No --background (-b) flag (use "Run >NIL: wget URL")
  - No --use-askpass (use --password instead)
  - No --timeout per-operation (TCP-level timeouts still work)
  - No gzip transfer encoding (servers send uncompressed)
  - No internationalized domain names (ASCII URLs only)
  - English only (NLS disabled)

System requirements:
  - AmigaOS 3.0 or later
  - 68020 or higher CPU
  - bsdsocket.library (Roadshow, AmiTCP, or Miami)
  - 1MB free RAM recommended

Includes full source code (original POSIX and ported Amiga versions)
and PORT.md documenting every transformation applied.
porting_notes: Phase 1: HTTP and FTP only (HTTPS via AmiSSL planned for Phase 2). Key transformations: BSD socket calls replaced with bsdsocket-shim; getopt_long replaced with amiport/getopt.h (libnix broken, crash-patterns #17); SIGALRM-based timeouts stubbed (same as Windows wget path); fork_to_background stubbed with AmigaDOS Run workaround; regex uses bundled gnulib engine. Critical memory fix: upstream cleanup() gated on DEBUG_MALLOC preprocessor — removed #ifdef guards so all 50+ xfree() calls run unconditionally on AmigaOS. 68/68 FS-UAE tests pass. First wget for AmigaOS without ixemul.library. Binary is 68020+ targeting for future AmiSSL integration.
known_limitations: HTTPS not yet supported (Phase 2 via AmiSSL planned). No --background (-b) flag (use 'Run >NIL: wget URL' instead). No --use-askpass (use --password instead). No --timeout per-operation (TCP-level timeouts via select() still work). No gzip transfer encoding (zlib disabled — servers send uncompressed). No internationalized domain names (libidn2 disabled, ASCII URLs only). English only (NLS disabled). NTLM proxy auth disabled. Requires bsdsocket.library (Roadshow, AmiTCP, or Miami).
